summary: The global marketing team is executing a two-track push: finalizing the Knowledge website redesign and advancing the China Going-Global report while resolving an urgent Outlook account lockout that is blocking team access.
summaryDetail: The most immediate issue is the Outlook account lockout caused by repeated old-password requests; the team must delete and re-login on all devices and confirm backend unlock with CKGSB IT today. On the Knowledge website redesign, the team has decided to keep the current design with menu categorization improvements and an editorial-style layout for articles, incorporating BCI/BSI indices; Joseph will share the HTML concept and a 30-minute feedback session is needed this week to finalize changes. For the China Going-Global report, Joseph is drafting the target audience and priority areas document, while the team analyzes participant profiles and CRM leads, and the conversion tracking audit is pending. Looking ahead, the team is prioritizing Asia Start and Intelligent China for search/AI visibility, with the Berkeley program as a possible third priority, and must align on outstanding items for the Nov 13 event and the ESG report draft.

decisions.text: Remove the standalone videos section; videos will be dispersed by topic instead.
Keep the current Knowledge design largely as-is rather than a full revamp, with menu categorization as the main change.
Use Joseph's editorial-style layout as inspiration for displaying more articles, not to be followed exactly.
Bring BCI and BSI indices into the Knowledge section, similar to the school homepage banner.
Do not add a stock-market ticker at the top of the homepage.
Prioritize Asia Star and Intelligent China as top two programs; US programs (Stanford, Columbia) on hold initially.
Berkeley program to be considered as a possible third priority and included in the audit phase.
Joseph updated the Homepage/Knowledge PPT based on this week's discussion
